title: Israeli Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir released a video humiliating Palestinian detainees and mocking them over their hunger and suffering in Israeli prisons. After prisoners complained about a lack of food, Ben-Gvir told them they would receive no more food, said he had no sympathy for their hunger, and taunted them: “This is not a hotel. You will die.”
text: Israeli Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir released a video humiliating Palestinian detainees and mocking them over their hunger and suffering in Israeli prisons. After prisoners complained about a lack of food, Ben-Gvir told them they would receive no more food, said he had no sympathy for their hunger, and taunted them: “This is not a hotel. You will die.”
